# Frontend acceptance scope and remaining gates

The phase checkpoints are **implementation/evidence checkpoints**, not blanket product completion. The local Hermes TUI, Electron controls and web-hosted TUI remain the current surfaces. The separate Dots repository has not been changed or cut over. Backend state and authorization are canonical; these views never start an independent agent loop, memory store or scheduler.

## Local consumer completion being consolidated in FE13

- FE00–01: discoverable runtime controls, strict owned-session capability/identity/memory health, disconnected/unknown states. Primary personal harness is opaque/unconfigured when its real contract is unavailable; specialists keep isolated built-in memory.
- FE02: existing project/capture/scoped-memory commands; actual supplied-output influence inspection and exact next-boundary controls for supported built-in records. Typed capture processing/search/batch review consumes schema44, including unindexed exact-ID inspection and complete verified original download. Neither local lexical search nor a fresh memory packet is broad semantic/causal knowledge.
- FE03: verified complete artifact bytes, precise sections, selected branch merge, immutable versions, exact prepared publication, saved template definitions and actual new-topic template application. Branch/template publication remains distinct from delivery. Explicit structure/styles apply; assets retain lineage only and unspecified prose styles are advisory.
- FE04: conversation outcome/current snapshot and next step, exact required outputs, verify/accept, steer/cancel and independent delivery recovery. Admission and transport acceptance never mean completed work or human reading.
- FE05–07: retained-source brief/manifest review, repeat workflow controls and bounded local monitors; selected data and prompt-only creative package paths. Account-pinned Gmail-thread and Calendar availability snapshots are explicit prepare/review/publish flows with complete cached-byte preview; general provider discovery, scenario decision UI, lesson/tutor/demo breadth and actual media generation remain separate unqualified or unselected work.
- FE08: explicit candidate acceptance/decline, source-backed draft-only correspondence and day/week fixed/flexible/overflow planning from a retained availability snapshot. No provider send, calendar write or live availability claim; terminal/superseded obligations stay terminal.
- FE09–10: finite local registered service execution, real receipt inspection, configured named single-specialist selection/handoff/status, owned channel/media controls and configured nonstreaming local-backend voice with explicit client capture/playback. No silent reroute to a cloud provider; gateway-local processing may occur on another machine.
- FE11–12: bounded status, exact broker-owned repair/privacy review and application, explicit selected-project deterministic opportunity dispositions, and read-only recorded decision explanations. Missing queues never imply all-clear. Off/shadow defaults and deterministic policy/approval floors remain unchanged.

## Final consumer follow-up and remaining implementation boundaries

The original FE13 receipt remains immutable for its original checkpoint. The additive consumers are qualified separately in [FE13 follow-up](fe13-followup-validation.json), against backend contract candidate `b323e73f7b2f6792c57341240e206a72e43e3192`. These are offline implementation receipts, not live acceptance.

- Full team dependency/budget/synthesis selection and measured coordination value remain separate, disabled breadth. Named configured specialist selection is an explicit single-child path with isolated built-in memory and parent review; it does not activate teams.
- Bounded deterministic opportunity discovery is explicit and selected-project scoped. Save/dismiss/accept records a choice; accepting opens existing review controls and grants no execution authority. Operator repair/privacy controls use exact broker-generated plans and separate confirmation. Broad setup orchestration and certified complete erasure remain unsupported.
- LAYA feedback/override/ambient policy and approval-friction optimization controls require real backend contracts and qualified gates. No trained-model rollout follows from displaying receipts.
- Cross-device authenticated routing choice, external channel mappings, transcription→document demonstration and browser consequential-submit completion evidence need their actual supported executors/adapters.
- Personal-harness record mutation remains unsupported without a verified contract; built-in record controls do not establish personal-harness completeness.
- Strict speech requires explicit finite admission before microphone or synthesis. Original operation/account IDs and actual budget receipts stay visible; an unknown media outcome is inspect-only, never an automatic audio replay or budget reset. Streaming STT feedback is not implemented by the configured nonstreaming adapter. Live STT/TTS needs an explicitly configured, already-installed local model/package on a supported backend host; this task installs no model or credentials.
- Image/OCR/PDF understanding is not implied by local UTF-8 capture indexing. Metadata filing/consolidation preserves originals and does not move bytes or expand grants.

## Localization and scope recovery

New forms use the existing nine-locale authority through a finite feature-local copy table and explicit parameterized confirmation templates. Identifiers, source excerpts and retained protocol receipts are not automatically translated. Scope changes use explicit identity/generation guards; same-object socket reconnect invalidates prepared request authority synchronously. A bounded ephemeral cache retains only original recovery identifiers for exact owning gateway/route/session inspection, never policy or approval authority.

## Independent qualification gates

- Synthetic focused component/RPC fixtures are implementation evidence, not real-provider, native-platform, hardware or deployment qualification.
- Full workspace suites, type/build/lint and exact phase-boundary checks are recorded in FE13's receipt when complete. Failures, blocked modules and not-run platforms must remain individually visible.
- Browser visual QA was attempted using the existing desktop Vite configuration and a clearly labeled test-only fixture. Vite started successfully. Cloud Browser blocked the loopback fixture URL under its URL policy. No bypass or external exposure was attempted. Thus screenshots and keyboard/narrow-window visual verification are **pending**, even when jsdom tests pass.
- Native Electron/node-pty install scripts were intentionally disabled during lock-respecting dependency hydration. The packaged-test skip flag did not skip a missing package: the test attempted a native rebuild, which failed before producing a package. This failed attempt is retained in the receipt; it was not retried. Native launch, audio hardware/permissions and cross-platform packaging are not certified here.
- The six complete source journeys and matched ten-task human-effort pilot are not proven by test counts. Variable model results, failure/review/cleanup effort, latency and cost need comparable evidence.
- Repository publication remains local-only while ordinary authenticated Git push is unavailable. No alternate GitHub blob publication is used.

## Recovery and rollback

Closing/detaching a view stops its listeners/client capture/playback, not accepted missions or committed effects. Unknown write identities remain inspectable and are not blindly replayed. Delivery retry never reruns work; cancellation is a real backend command and never automatic rollback. Reverting UI leaves retained backend receipts, artifacts, mappings and pending work intact. Dots remains read-only handoff work until its own adapter and single-owner cutover gates pass.
